about.heading: ./about
about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm an ASIX student (Computer Systems and Networks Administration) and I've just finished DAW, so I have a web development background: Laravel, React, Vue, MySQL and REST APIs.
At Synkiria I did automation, not web development: I replaced manual tasks with n8n and integrated Odoo with other systems through REST APIs.
I'm now moving into systems and networking: Linux, Windows Server, networks, virtualization and security. I learn by building things, so I document my labs and practice projects.
about.card_sys_text: My main focus right now: Linux, Windows Server, networking, virtualization and security. I learn by building labs and documenting what I do.
about.card_work_text: Looking for an ASIX internship in systems, IT support or infrastructure around Tarragona / Barcelona.
